mediaWork.title: Long Shot
mediaWork.focusOrTheme: Wrongful accusation, securing an alibi through unlikely means (TV show footage).
mediaWork.summaryNotes: When Juan Catalan is arrested for a murder he swears he didn't commit, he builds his case for innocence around raw footage from a popular TV show, "Curb Your Enthusiasm."

mediaItems.focusOrTheme: Wrongful accusation, securing an alibi through unlikely means (TV show footage).
mediaItems.summaryNotes: This short documentary focuses on the unique way Juan Catalan's lawyer proved his client's alibi, using footage from "Curb Your Enthusiasm." Catalan claimed he was at a Dodgers game during the time of the murder he was accused of, and the lawyer discovered the footage, which corroborated Catalan's alibi and led to the charges being dropped.

featuredIndividuals.narrativeSummary: Juan Catalan was wrongfully accused of the murder of Martha Puebla. He was arrested and jailed pre-trial, but the charges were dismissed after his alibi was confirmed by HBO footage showing him at a Dodgers game.
